2c295b08ef9cae4221e7.headline: UMkhandlu waseGoli uzokhetha imeya kanti isivumelwano siletha i-ANC
2c295b08ef9cae4221e7.dek: Kuthiwa kunesivumelwano samaqembu amane okuyi-ANC, i-ActionSA, i-MK kanye ne-EFF, uHerman Mashaba ongase ahole idolobha.
2c295b08ef9cae4221e7.why: Izakhamizi zaseGoli zizoba nemeya entsha nobuholi bomkhandlu obuzoya ngokuthi isivumelwano se-ANC simelana kanjani nomzamo weDA wokuhlehlisa udaba.
paragraphs: Umkhandlu kamasipala omusha waseGoli uhlelelwe ukuthi ukhethe imeya emhlanganweni wokuqala ngoMsombuluko mhla ziyi-23 kuNovemba, njengoba izingxoxo zemifelandawonye ziphetha. Umholi we-ActionSA uHerman Mashaba kuthiwa usesicongweni sokuthatha lesi sikhundla. Umhlangano, obekelwe ihora le-13:00 e-Connie Bapela Council Chambers, uzophinde ufake izifungo kumacebhalo futhi ukhethe usomlomo nezinye izikhulu.

I-Daily Maverick ibike ukuthi i-African National Congress (ANC), i-ActionSA, i-MK okuwuhuquzu we-uMkhonto weSizwe, kanye ne-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) bavumelene ngokubusa iGoli, iTshwane kanye neEkurhuleni. Lungekho iqembu eliwine ngqwambile eGoli. I-Democratic Alliance (DA) ithole amavoti amaningi kule ndawo ngo-34.84%, kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi ahlale esiphikweni.
I-DA icele umphathi wedolobha laseGoli uFloyd Brink ukuthi ahlehlise umhlangano, ngokusho kwe-TimesLIVE, ithi izingxoxo zemifelandawonye ziyaqhubeka.

44b5e7827aaf4272cb5e.headline: U-Khumalo nabaphathi abaphezulu abayisihlanu bafuna over R112m
44b5e7827aaf4272cb5e.dek: Isikhulu seCrime Intelligence nabanye basola ukushushiswa ngokungafanele nokuboshwa ngokungekho emthethweni emva kokuba amacala esusiwe.
44b5e7827aaf4272cb5e.why: Uhulumeni kumele aphendule ngesicelo esidlula R112 wezigidi esivela ezikhulwini; esikaKhumalo saba yedwa siyizigidi ezingu-28 zamarandi.
paragraphs: UDumisani Khumalo, oyisikhulu seCrime Intelligence eNingizimu Afrika, namaphoyisa aphezulu ayisihlanu bafuna ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-112 zamarandi kuhulumeni emva kokuhoxiswa kwamacala enkohliso nenkulumompikiswano abebhekene nawo. Isaziso sabo somthetho, esikhishwe mhla ziyi-19 kuNovemba 2026, sisola abashushisi nabaphenyi ngokushushisa ngokungafanele, ukuboshwa nokugcinwa esitokisini ngokungekho emthethweni.

Izikhulu zisola ukuthi uphenyo lusekelwe encwadini yefika engeyinhle nokuthi umphenyi wadukisa umantshi ukuze athole izincwadi zokuboshwa. Baphinde bathi banqatshelwa ukudla ngenkathi beboshiwe. Icala likahulumeni ladilika emva kwezinyanga ezingaba ngu-14, ngokusho kwesaziso somthetho. U-Khumalo ufuna izigidi ezingu-28 zamarandi, ecaphuna umonakalo empilweni yakhe, izindleko zokwelashwa, izindleko zomthetho kanye nomonakalo wesithunzi sakhe.

Isaziso sisho owayeyiNhloko ye-Investigating Directorate Against Corruption u-Andrea Johnson, umphenyi uBrian Padayachee nezinhlangano zikahulumeni eziningi phakathi kwalabo abathintekayo. Izinsolo ziyizicelo ezisemacaleni.

909320183c2e55b8145d.headline: INingizimu Afrika ilila ngoPhumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka owayeyiphini lempilo
909320183c2e55b8145d.dek: UMlambo-Ngcuka, oshone eneminyaka engu-71 emva kwezinkinga zokuhlinzwa, ube yiphini likamongameli kusuka ngo-2005 kuya ku-2008.
909320183c2e55b8145d.why: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika balahlekelwa ngowesifazane wokuqala ukuba yiphini likamongameli, isikhundla asiphethe kusuka ngoJuni 2005 kuya kuSepthemba 2008.
paragraphs: UPhumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, oyiphini likaMengameli wesifazane wokuqala eNingizimu Afrika, ushone ngoLwesihlanu eneminyaka engu-71 emva kwezinkinga zenqubo yezokwelapha cishe emasontweni amabili ngaphambi kwalokho. Ungene ephalamende lokuqala lentsandokazi yeningi lezwe ngo-1994 waba ungqongqoshe wezohwebo nezimboni eminyakeni emibili emva kwalokho.

Uthathe umnyango wezemisebenzi yezimandla namandla ngomnyaka ka-1999 wawubamba iminyaka eyisithupha. NgoJuni 2005, waba yiphini likamongameli, waze wakhonza kuze kube uSepthemba 2008, lapho eshiya khona emva kokuhamba kukaMengameli Thabo Mbeki. Okhulumela yena uthe ucashunwe ngezizathu zakhe siqu futhi wayefuna umongameli ozayo aqoke elakhe iphini.

UMlambo-Ngcuka ujoyine iCongress of the People ngoMashi 2009, wabe esebuyela ku-African National Congress. Ngo-Agasti 2013 waba ngumqondisi omkhulu we-UN Women kanye n secrétaire jenerali waphansi weNhlangano yezizwe.

2070d238ab1f1695d7ea.headline: Amaphoyisa aseBrazil athola u-600kg kokeine ophenyweni lwekhateli
2070d238ab1f1695d7ea.dek: Uphenyo luqale ngemuva kokuthi umshayeli wendiza wase-Australia uTimothy Clark ephahlakele eBrazil ngo-2025 no-202kg wekokeine endizeni esuka eNingizimu Afrika.
2070d238ab1f1695d7ea.why: Abantu abanezingibe zaseNingizimu Afrika bathinteka ophenyweni oluholele ekuboshweni eBrazil nasePerth, kuyilapho amaphoyisa elandela inethiwekhi yekokeine.
paragraphs: Amaphoyisa aseBrazil nase-Australia athole ngaphezu kuka-600kg wekokeine futhi abamba abantu abaningana eBrazil, ophenyweni oluhlobene nokuphahlakaka kwendiza kuka-2025. Uphenyo luxhumanisa iNingizimu Afrika nekhateli lomhlaba wonke, ngokusho kombiko.

Umshayeli wendiza wase-Australia uTimothy Clark ushone ngenkathi indiza encane ayishayela isuka eNingizimu Afrika iphahlakaka ensimini yomoba eCoruripe, esifundeni sase-Alase Brazil, mhla ziyi-13 kuSepthemba 2025. Iziphathimandla zithole u-202kg wekokeine endaweni yesigameko, enophawu lwe-SpaceX olungelona iqiniso. UClark ubexhunywe ophenyweni oluholele ekuboshweni kwabantu ababili ePerth, omunye enobudlelwane naseNingizimu Afrika.
Amaphoyisa eZwe laseBrazil amemezele ezinye zezinguquko zakamuva mhla ziyi-18 kuNovemba 2026. Umbiko awubanga nabantu ababoshiwe emkhankasweni omusha waseBrazil.

e506bd0a4f124fe979b3.headline: AmaBhokobhoko azobhekana neFrance koweNations Championship
e506bd0a4f124fe979b3.dek: Ukunqoba kweFrance ngo 45-17 over i-Argentina kubayise phambili, kanti iNingizimu Afrika yafinyelela kowamanqamu yize ihlulwe yi-Ireland ngo 20-17 eDublin.
e506bd0a4f124fe979b3.why: Abalandeli bamaBhokobhoko eNingizimu Afrika naphesheya manje sebangahlela kowamanqamu ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-29 kuNovemba, eTwickenham.
paragraphs: Ukunqoba kweFrance ngo 45-17 over i-Argentina ngoMgqibelo kuqinisekise indawo yabo kowamanqamu weNations Championship yangempelasonto ezayo neNingizimu Afrika eTwickenham. Umphumela wamaphuzu ebhonasi unikeze iFrance indawo yokuqala echibini lasentshonalanga, ngaphambi kweNgilandi ne-Ireland, kanti i-Argentina yehlela endaweni yesine etafuleni laseningizimu.

INingizimu Afrika yehluleke ngo 20-17 ne-Ireland e-Aviva Stadium eDublin, kodwa iphakethe labo lebhonasi lokuhlulwa ngaphansi kwamaphuzu ayisishiyolwane libagcine phezulu etafuleni laseningizimu ngamaphuzu omehluko, ngaphambi kweNew Zealand. IFrance yayidinga amaphuzu ayisihlanu aphelele ukuze ifinyelele kowamanqamu ngemuva kokuba iNgilandi ishaye iNew Zealand ekuqaleni ngoMgqibelo.

I-Argentina, ebibambe iqhaza kahle emdlalweni kuze kube amakhadi amabili esigaba sesibili eyindleko, izodlala neScotland ngendawo yesikhombisa ngesonto elizayo. Owamanqamu uhlelelwe ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-29 kuNovemba, ngehora le-18:40 ngesikhathi saseNingizimu Afrika.
